answers.reason: The president chairs the central bodies of the university, which includes the senate.
The budget planning round is a central budget matter overseen by university leadership.
The appointment committee is a faculty-level body, and leadership does not intervene in individual bodies.
The faculty council is handled by faculty members and led by the dean.
The study commission is a faculty body for teaching matters.
The examination board handles faculty-level examination matters.
The internal research funding round is a faculty-level committee.
The module revision working group belongs to a specific degree programme.
Laboratory equipment procurement is a specific faculty-level matter.
Orientation week planning is a faculty or student level matter.
